hook.name: AuthSwaps
hook.description: Restricts all pool operations to callers in an owner-managed `trustedSenders` allowlist. Swaps additionally require the resolved user to pass `checkUser` (whitelisted and not banned) via the Manifest Finance `IAuthManager`. Liquidity operations, initialization, and donations additionally require the resolved sender to be a registered manifest account via the same `IAuthManager`. The auth manager address is updatable by the owner subject to a 7-day timelock.
